config.worldPremise: Wordlark Hollow is a cozy, fantastical little town in the region of Earendale. It exists in a fictional world where a dragon fell on Denver That Was on October 15, 1980 and transported everything in its circumference to  a giant stone head the size of the moon floating through space. Everyone that was transported was turned into an anthropromorphic animal. It is now 100 years after that event. Magic is real in the world of the Great Head and can be cast using a device called a caster.

interactionView.title: Handbook for the Recently Transported
interactionView.body:
by Hensel VonCliffenwald

Have you been recently transported to the Great Head? Want to know where the latest and greatest hangouts are? Still trying to get the hang of the Flying spell? Read on dear traveler! Hensel VonCliffenwald will tell you everything you need to know.

nodes.text: I'm Horace Pennyfeather, Station Manager, and you must be Mim! Your Aunt Eloise is expecting you at the resort. If you need anything just hollar.
Thanks! Can you tell me where I can find my suitcase?

Usually they're here waiting for you, but there seems to be some irregularity today. It's been a most unusual. You may want to check up at the station while I look into it. If they don't have it up there then come and find me.
Yeah ... baggage claim is a bit of a mess today not sure what happened.
I think that lady is pretty upset though.
